_comment: Task 18-a i18n handoff — Interfaces inventory (network.interfaces). Namespace: netif. All rendered strings; admin/oper status option labels and the status badges REUSE the existing status.interfaceAdmin.* / status.interfaceOper.* keys via StatusBadge + useStatusLabel (already localized — do NOT duplicate). Clear-filters button reuses common.clear. Table 'Last flap' renders date-fns formatDistanceToNow (relative time mirrors the established ha-view pattern; generated by date-fns, not an i18n key). EN and AR have identical key sets (47 = 47). Merge as a flat 'netif' object (strip the 'netif.' prefix when nesting).
